name: Official A2A Python SDK
summary: The official Python SDK for implementing A2A 1.0 clients and servers, including protocol types, supported transports, and optional AgentCard signing utilities.

interfaces.name: Python SDK
interfaces.description: Official Python implementation of the A2A 1.0 specification with 0.3 compatibility mode.

limitations: The SDK is an independent upstream project and must be installed and reviewed separately.
Optional server, gRPC, signing, database, and telemetry extras have distinct dependency and security implications.
Huffman Protocol does not automatically execute agents or trust SDK declarations.
